senses.gloss: (b. h; cmp. טמם) to lie in wait for; to bear a grudge against, persecute.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67">Gen. R. s. 67</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01216"><he>סִנְטֵר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:7">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> (expl. <he>ריש̇ט̇ם̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 27:41">Gen. XXVII, 41</cite>) <he>ש̇נאה ט̇מ̇ונה</he> hidden hatred.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> <he>יוסף … יַיִּשְׂטְמוּהוּ והיו … ששוֹטְמָם וכ׳</he> his brothers sinned against Joseph, ‘and they persecuted him’ (<cite ref="Genesis 49:23">Gen. XLIX, 23</cite>), and his brothers thought that he would persecute them as they did him; <he>אבל עשו כששְׂטָמוֹ ליעקב וכ׳</he> but when Esau persecuted Jacob &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14<sup>5</sup></cite> <he>זה נ׳ וזה נ׳</he> this one (Jacob) was hated (<cite ref="Genesis 27:41">Gen. XXVII, 41</cite>), and that one (Joseph) was hated (ib. XLIX, 23).
